operation: Agentic AI developer-tool adoption - 10-company public-intelligence sweep
github_push_status: BLOCKED - git proxy and GitHub API both return 403 (read-only integration token, no contents:write). Work is committed locally only. Needs user to grant write access / re-auth, then re-push.
design_notes: TodoWrite tool is unavailable in this environment; per-company status is tracked in this file instead.

Phases A and B are produced by a single research pass per company (the same sources establish both existence and usage detail), but the two specified output files (_a_findings.json and _b_usage.json) are still written separately per company.

Confidence tiers assigned in phase C: T1=confirmed (company's own statement / earnings / official vendor case study naming the company), T2=strong (reputable journalism w/ named sourcing, conference talk, explicit job posting), T3=weak (single low-quality/SEO source or inference), T4=no evidence found.
Vendor nuance: Microsoft (owns GitHub Copilot), Google (makes Gemini CLI/Antigravity), Amazon (makes Q), Apple etc. may BUILD tools as well as USE them - these are tracked as distinct signals.
